label: THE_FADE_PHASE2_T76_LANE_B_SCOPED_MVP_GOVERNANCE_ACCEPTANCE_PACK
authoring_note: Governance-only tranche: no new evidence collected; cites existing on-disk artifacts per MVP_LANE_EVIDENCE_LOG.md and mvp_lane_evidence_registry.json.

scope.scope_statement: This pack addresses only the four included_dimensions for lane_b_official_disclosure. It does not address any other MVP dimension (including reliability), does not address stale_outage_behavior, and does not address any other lane.

freshness.factual_basis_on_disk: Tranches 31–32 classified the 22-slot Federal Register full-window rows under operator-facing policy; Prompt #132 adopted strict_midnight_utc in lane_b_phase2_freshness_policy_decision.json. Registry and log document 12 fresh / 0 stale / 10 cannot_classify_honestly for that window (t30_valid_002 excluded from tally per existing discipline).
freshness.accepted_only_as: Operator accepts using the adopted freshness interpretation and the documented honest partiality (cannot_classify rows) as the scoped MVP stance for Lane B on this evidence window — not as proof of freshness closure on all possible FR rows or future windows.
freshness.residual_limits_not_accepted_away: Full freshness closure on all documents; alternate calendar policies as primary; using freshness alone as proof of whole gate; production-scale freshness monitoring.
freshness.operator_facing_reason: Acceptable for scoped MVP documentation because policy is explicit on disk and limitations are named, not hidden.
freshness.overclaim_guard: dimension_evidence_status remains partial in registry; this acceptance is governance labeling of existing partial evidence, not a claim of full gate closure.

normalization_viability.factual_basis_on_disk: Tranches 34, 50, 58 document normalization breadth and silent-drop traces on bounded cases and stored 22-slot slice: collector retention and partial normalization support evidenced; full normalized_signal_event materialization from stored preview remains explicitly out of bounds per audits.
normalization_viability.accepted_only_as: Operator accepts documenting normalization behavior as evidenced for the bounded FR slice and fixture sets on disk — with explicit known limits (preview truncation, policy fill-ins) — as sufficient for scoped MVP **narrative** for this dimension at current evidence depth.
normalization_viability.residual_limits_not_accepted_away: Full API body parse on all rows; full live breadth; runtime-wide silent-drop proof beyond bounded audits.
normalization_viability.operator_facing_reason: Acceptable because residual limits are already written in audit outcomes; acceptance makes the stance explicit for primary_lane_rule requirement (b) for this dimension only at scoped MVP bar.
normalization_viability.overclaim_guard: Registry partial preserved; no claim that normalization_viability is production-closed.

conflict_handling.factual_basis_on_disk: Tranches 47, 52, 56, 60, 61 add local and stored-slice boundaries: fusion_policy alignment, stale-context omission in bounded fixtures, minimal conflict path truth, conflict-replay direction_hint policy JSON for stored slice.
conflict_handling.accepted_only_as: Operator accepts the documented bounded conflict/fusion semantics and replay labeling for Phase 2 scoped MVP — not full production conflict coverage or live fusion runtime proof.
conflict_handling.residual_limits_not_accepted_away: Full live FR conflict permutations; minimal path consuming freshness in production; complete conflict_handling closure.
conflict_handling.operator_facing_reason: Acceptable because the on-disk record already states gaps; this pack records operator acceptance of that bounded stance for scoped MVP.
conflict_handling.overclaim_guard: partial remains; T56/T60 gaps remain acknowledged in log.

context_dominance_risk.factual_basis_on_disk: Tranche 60 and related artifacts document context-only vs primary boundaries on stored slice; lane_b_phase2_conflict_replay_policy_decision.json constrains replay labeling; context-only contra example is local.
context_dominance_risk.accepted_only_as: Operator accepts the documented non-dominance / boundary statements for scoped MVP at the evidenced depth — not proof that context cannot dominate in all production paths.
context_dominance_risk.residual_limits_not_accepted_away: Live multi-source fusion at scale; Research Swarm integration; universal non-dominance proof.
context_dominance_risk.operator_facing_reason: Acceptable as explicit governance stance matching existing documented limits.

explicit_non_acceptance.stale_outage_behavior: NOT settled, NOT accepted, NOT closed by this pack. Lane B standard #4 / stale-outage system behavior remains partial per prior audits (e.g. T35, T45, T54, T62, T63 narrative). Primary-lane eligibility cannot rest on this dimension without future governed work.
explicit_non_acceptance.reliability: NOT addressed by this pack. Reliability evidence (e.g. FR 22-slot slice) exists separately; this tranche does not add acceptance or closure for reliability.
explicit_non_acceptance.primary_lane_eligibility_rationale: phase2_mvp_approval_scope_decision.json primary_lane_rule requires every MVP dimension to have evidence at bar OR explicit governance treatment. This pack provides explicit governance treatment for four dimensions only. stale_outage_behavior and reliability (and any remaining primary_lane_rule gaps) are not satisfied by this pack alone. Therefore primary_lane_eligibility_met remains false after T76.

overall_outcome_meaning: A bounded governance acceptance record is established on disk for the four included dimensions under explicit residual limits. This is not an approval flip and not a claim that primary_lane_eligibility_met is true.
